page.layout: One printed page. Top: decorative ornament and rules, no running head. Centre: ornamental headpiece, then the dedication title block (full width). Below: one text column with a large woodcut initial C. Foot: signature "a 2" at left, catchword "nem" at right. No margin notes.

main_text.l: ΔΩΡΟΝ [?] illud vere βασιλικον Fratri tuo HEN-

page.notes: The large initial C is joined to "ardinalis" as "Cardinalis". The Greek words are set in small capitals in the print: ΔΩΡΟΝ is a probable reading (marked [?]), and βασιλικον is printed without accents. The catchword "nem" completes "omnem", which the text ends with the hyphenated "om-". The italic/roman distinctions in the body are approximate. The top rules and the faint text in the upper margin are not printed text. The "Digitized by Google" credit at the foot right is excluded.
